name: George Nelson
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: George is a qualified psychotherapist, coach, clinical counsellor, relationship therapist, educator, speech therapist, voice production and training consultant. George has worked in a range of public sector roles in addition to an independent practice as a clinician, senior executive, manager, supervisor and training consultant. As a therapist and educator George has worked with children, teenagers and adults to help them with cognition, behaviour, decision making, social and emotional intelligence, communication, speech, voice production - (certain clients include news-presenters, actors, reporters and radio announcers).

name: Holly Block
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Our relationships can heal us, but not in the ways we commonly think – not by controlling our partners or getting from them what we lacked as children. Rather, we heal by coming to terms with the ignored parts of ourselves. We acknowledge our wounded, triggered responses and shift into something wiser, more mature.

name: Irena Begelfor
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: THE JOURNEY THAT LED ME HERE … As a way of getting to know each other, I want to share where I have come from and why I chose to be a life coach/hypnotherapist. For much of my adult life I worked in the area of Information Technology (IT) for large corporations within Australia and frequently travelled internationally to impart business and technical knowledge. I changed many hats throughout my professional career where I always developed both my creative as well as logical skills.

name: Jodie Smart
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Jodie is an enthusiastic believer in the holistic approach to recovery from addictive disorders, She is an advocate for change and promotes self-efficacy through helping others find purpose in their lives and provides hope to those on their recovery journey. Specialising in addiction, trauma, grief and loss, her decades of experience provides her with exceptional skills to create safe spaces to work with co-occurring disorders through both a interpersonal clinical approach and somatic breathwork. Specialising in addiction, trauma, grief and loss. Psychology/ Counselling BA ACA member, Clinical Supervisor CSAT candidate( Certified Sex Addiction Therapist) Breathwork facilitator, Somatic Therapist Meditation teacher
